bites.title: One window. That's it.
bites.body:
This is the 3D Viewport, the room where everything in Blender happens. Everything else is hidden for now. You'll earn it back, piece by piece.

Press F1 over anything, anytime, and it explains itself.

bites.title: Orbit
bites.body: Hold the middle mouse button and drag. You're circling the cube like a moon.
bites.hint: Middle mouse means pressing the scroll wheel down like a button. No wheel? Drag the colored axis ball in the top-right corner.

bites.title: Zoom
bites.body: Roll the mouse wheel over the viewport (not over this card). Closer. Farther. Go nuts.
bites.hint: Or drag the magnifying glass icon in the top-right corner up and down.

bites.title: Pan
bites.body: Hold Shift and drag with the middle mouse button. The view slides sideways like a camera on rails.
bites.hint: Or drag the little hand icon in the top-right corner.

bites.title: Snap to front
bites.body: Press 1 on the number pad. Boom: front view, flat and orthographic, like a blueprint.
bites.hint: No numpad? Click the green circle marked -Y on the axis ball (top-right).

bites.title: Pick it
bites.body: Left-click the cube. It glows orange. Orange means 'I'm the one you're talking to.'
bites.hint: Click anywhere on the cube's faces, not its outline.

bites.title: Find it again
bites.body: We just shoved the view off to the side. Press the period key on the number pad and Blender swoops back to whatever is selected.
bites.hint: No numpad? Press the ` key (left of 1) and choose Frame Selected from the pie.

bites.title: Grab it
bites.body: Press G, wiggle the mouse, then left-click to drop it. G is for Grab. Your new best friend.
bites.hint: Your mouse must be over the viewport when you press G.

bites.title: On rails
bites.body: Press G, then X. The cube is now locked to the red X axis. Move it, click. Red is X, green is Y, blue is Z. Forever.
bites.hint: G first, then X, then move the mouse. Order matters.

bites.title: Exactly 2 meters
bites.body: G, then X, then type 2 and press Enter. No mouse needed. Precision mode activated.
bites.hint: Type the 2 while the cube is still moving, then Enter.
bites.praise: Two meters. Not one millimeter more.

bites.title: Spin
bites.body: Press R to rotate. Feeling fancy? Try R, Z, 45, Enter for a crisp 45 degree turn.

bites.title: Grow
bites.body: Press S to scale. Pull the mouse away from the cube to grow it, push toward it to shrink. Click to confirm.

bites.title: Take it back
bites.body: Made a mess? Ctrl+Z undoes. Undo until your cube is back to its normal size.
bites.hint: Ctrl+Z, maybe once, maybe twice. Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes if you overshoot.

bites.title: Lesson 00: cleared
bites.body:
You can orbit, zoom, pan, snap views, select, grab, rotate, scale, and undo. That's the whole foundation.

Reward: the header and toolbar just appeared. Hover anything up there and press F1. Scroll on for Lesson 01: Seeing.
